[Controller decode 2026-07-09] Non-player QueryControlState consumer: Attack control 4 held/pressed gates actor weapon attack handling.

Top-level PlayerCharacter attack-control handler; sole direct caller is Player_OnInput at 0x672664. Native ABI is bool __thiscall with no x87/stack arguments. It reads the current process attack gate (vtable +0x138), handles ordinary attack control, and in the Bow lane coordinates AttackBow Hold/release state across third- and first-person ActorAnimData. The prior ST0/ST1 parameters and non-player description were decompiler artifacts.
